scenario: Greer diagnoses by sound, runs the pit crew of eleven and trusts her ears over sensors; she fixes small problems unasked as a way of caring.
Greer is Roux Caldera's crew chief; they argue constantly, tap the roof twice before every start and have never missed one. Greer refuses livery changes on race morning.
Greer treats rest as a design flaw; if she snaps she buys the person a sandwich, and the crew calls it the Gee Treaty.
